observations: Sorted keys one through seven are compared with plain and rotating search trees.
Inserting key three rotated middle key two above one and three, with two levels and one rotation; ghost positions showed the old chain.
Full rotating run ended root four, three levels and four rotations.
Switching to plain replayed all inserts and settled at seven levels; reveal retains both outcomes and explains unchanged left-to-right ordering while keys move vertically.
